panels.title: Share of YMML-YSSY airborne time flown by local pilots (Mondays 0700-1200Z)
panels.description: Share of Melbourne-Sydney airborne time flown by home-region pilots on flights that ended between 0700 and 1200 UTC on a Monday; one bar per Monday (UTC), labelled DD-MM-YYYY.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "Monday (UTC)",
       round(100.0 * COALESCE(sum(f.airborne_minutes) FILTER (WHERE f.pilot_is_local), 0)
             / NULLIF(sum(f.airborne_minutes), 0), 1) AS "Local pilots (%)"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND extract(isodow FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 1
  AND (f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::time >= time '07:00'
  AND (f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::time < time '12:00'
  AND ((f.departure = 'YMML' AND f.arrival = 'YSSY') OR (f.departure = 'YSSY' AND f.arrival = 'YMML'))
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY date_trunc('week', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
ORDER BY date_trunc('week', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')

panels.title: Aircraft airborne during the Monday event window, each Monday (0700-1200Z)
panels.description: For each Monday (UTC) in the last 5 years that has any, the number of distinct finished flights that were connected at some moment between 0700 and 1200 UTC and had airborne time above 0 (groundspeed of 60 kt or more at some point, as on the weekday and weekend charts). A flight that overlaps the window by even one minute counts once, however long it spans it. The flight summary stores when a flight started and ended and its total airborne minutes, not when it was airborne, so a flight that took off and landed outside the window but stayed connected into it is counted: the bars are an upper bound of the aircraft actually in the air during the window. Flights imported from historical records are included (no altitude data is needed for this count). A flight counts about 8 hours after its last position, so the latest Monday fills in during that evening. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
-- Each flight is expanded to the UTC days it touches; only Mondays are kept, so the query reads the flights once
SELECT to_char(m.monday, 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "Monday (UTC)",
       count(DISTINCT f.session_id) AS "Aircraft airborne"
FROM flight f
CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(date_trunc('day', f.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
                                   date_trunc('day', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), interval '1 day') AS d(day)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT d.day::date AS monday,
                           (d.day::date + time '07:00') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS win_start,
                           (d.day::date + time '12:00') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS win_end) m
WHERE f.airborne_minutes > 0
  AND f.end_time >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz
  AND f.start_time <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
  AND extract(isodow FROM d.day) = 1
  AND f.start_time < m.win_end
  AND f.end_time > m.win_start
  AND m.win_start BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz AND ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
GROUP BY m.monday
ORDER BY m.monday

panels.title: Controllers online during the Monday event window, each Monday (0700-1200Z)
panels.description: For each Monday (UTC) in the last 5 years that has any, the number of distinct controllers (CIDs) with a session connected at some moment between 0700 and 1200 UTC. A session that starts before 1200 and ends at or after 0700 counts, however long it spans the window or how short its overlap; a controller with several sessions in the window counts once. Only whitelisted positions are stored. A session appears once it has ended. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
-- Each session is expanded to the UTC days it touches; only Mondays are kept, so the query reads the sessions once
SELECT to_char(m.monday, 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "Monday (UTC)",
       count(DISTINCT s.cid) AS "Controllers online"
FROM controller_session_ranked s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(date_trunc('day', s.session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),
                                   date_trunc('day', s.session_end AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), interval '1 day') AS d(day)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT d.day::date AS monday,
                           (d.day::date + time '07:00') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS win_start,
                           (d.day::date + time '12:00') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS win_end) m
WHERE s.session_end >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz
  AND s.session_start <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
  AND extract(isodow FROM d.day) = 1
  AND s.session_start < m.win_end
  AND s.session_end >= m.win_start
  AND m.win_start BETWEEN ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz AND ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
GROUP BY m.monday
ORDER BY m.monday
